# Two floors. Downstairs: a big living room, the hall (front door at the
# bottom leads out onto Citadel Island), kitchen and bathroom. Upstairs
# (the back half, 4 cells up, stairs from the hall): the study, where a
# Grobo goes through his checklist at the drafting table, a landing and
# a bedroom. Talk to anyone with the action key, and search the furniture
# (action key in front of it). Watch out for the trap door in the hall.
